LanguageData.CC_Task_Msg_Set_2: {PAWN} has a task from the council as {OFFICE}: {KIND}, with {TARGET}.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Msg_Set_3: The council sets {PAWN}, its {OFFICE}, to {KIND}, with {TARGET}.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_WinOver_2: {NAME} writes back at more length than usual, and asks {PAWN} to keep writing.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_WinOver_3: {NAME} answers {PAWN} as one answers a friend now, not a stranger.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_Trade_2: {NAME} sends a list of prices, and marks the goods their people are short of.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_Trade_3: {NAME} writes that their caravan could stop at the colony on its rounds, if the goods are good.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_BringHome_2: {NAME} answers that {OURS} is kept under guard and well enough, and that something could be arranged.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_TheirKin_2: {NAME} asks after their kin by name, and says an offer will follow.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_KeepFaith_2: {NAME} writes that the colony's prayers are said at their own rites too.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_SpeakFaith_2: {NAME} argues every point of the colony's letter, and asks for another.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_Host_2: {NAME} writes that their people would come gladly, and asks what to bring.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Ans_Moot_2: {NAME} answers kindly enough, about matters the colony has moved past.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Visit_Arrived_2: {PAWN} is at {TOWN} on the colony's business, received in their way: {RITE}.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Patrol_Quiet_2: {PAWN} came in from the dawn walk round {COLONY} with nothing to report but sore feet.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Patrol_Quiet_3: {PAWN} walked the edges of {COLONY} at first light. Quiet all the way round.
LanguageData.CC_Task_TradeOffer_2: {WHO} writes for {PEOPLE}: the letters have been worth the reading, and they propose {KIND}, {RITE} as their ways ask.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Watch_2: {PAWN} sat up late near the guests from {PEOPLE}, and walked with them a while.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Watch_3: After dark, {PAWN} kept the guests from {PEOPLE} company, and kept an eye on them.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Caught_Talk_2: {OTHER} worked out what {PAWN} was after, and {NAME} will hear of it. {NAME} thinks less of the colony, and of {PAWN} most of all.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Caught_Informer_2: The informer sold word of {PAWN} as well, and {NAME} bought it. {NAME} thinks less of the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Caught_Visit_2: Someone at their town told {NAME} who {PAWN} had been asking about. {NAME} thinks less of the colony, and of {PAWN} most of all.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Press_Yes_2: {NAME} has agreed to send {SILVER} silver so that nobody hears {NAME} {SECRET}. The letter is short and cold.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Press_No_2: {NAME} told the colony to do its worst. It has: the neighbors now know that {NAME} {SECRET}, and {PEOPLE} know who told them.
LanguageData.CC_Keeper_Ans_Moot_2: {NAME} doesn't answer the matter at all.
